# Definition

Monthly Revenue represents the total recognized recurring revenue for a calendar month.

# Calculation

Sum of all active subscription charges recognized in the month.

# Recognition Rules

Revenue is recognized when:
1. Service is delivered
2. Payment is reasonably assured
3. Amount is measurable
